issues.description: Default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta disagrees between code (shubh) and docs (aditya).
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh' while the PR description, module docstring, and class docstring all promise 'aditya'. This contract drift between specification and implementation will silently give callers the wrong voice. Pick one source of truth and make code and docs agree.

issues.description: Ignored-parameter warnings compare against defaults, conflating intent with default value.
issues.detail: Checks like params.pitch != 0.0, params.loudness != 1.0, params.temperature != 0.6 fire spuriously when a caller explicitly passes the default and stay silent when a caller intends the default. Use a None sentinel or explicit-set detection so the warning reflects caller intent rather than the value happening to equal a default.

issues.description: Silent pace clamping violates the InputParams range contract.
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace with Field(ge=0.3, le=3.0), but v3-beta silently clamps to 0.5-2.0. This narrows the advertised precondition without telling callers and is inconsistent with how prompt/mode/language are strictly rejected elsewhere. Either raise ValueError on out-of-range or split InputParams per model so the type reflects reality.

issues.description: Voice_id is never validated against the per-model speakers tuple.
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS carries a speakers tuple per model and v2/v3 speaker enums exist, but __init__ never checks voice_id against the selected model. A v2 speaker sent to v3-beta fails server-side instead of raising a clear client-side ValueError. Use the data you already built.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models.
issues.detail: The helper returns v2 speakers for any unrecognized model name, which is a quiet wrong answer that conflicts with __init__ rejecting unknown models via ValueError. Either raise on unknown input or return an empty list so callers can distinguish unknown from v2.

issues.description: Speaker list duplicated between Enums and the config tuple.
issues.detail: SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums and TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS.speakers encode the same data twice and must be kept in sync. Pick one source of truth — keep speakers in the config and drop the enums, or key the config off the enums. Decorative type-safety is not worth duplication.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor direction is right: replacing substring model sniffing with data-driven ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig tables is cleaner and more maintainable. Blocking concerns cluster around contract drift: the v3-beta default speaker disagrees between code and docs, ignored-parameter warnings misuse default values as intent signals, pace is silently clamped against the declared InputParams range, and voice_id is never validated against the per-model speakers tuple that the PR just built. Secondary cleanup: get_speakers_for_model should not silently fall back to v2, and the speaker enums duplicate the config's speakers data. Land after fixing the P1 contract issues.
